title: Cache the invoke
prompt: Implement `static Func<object?, object?> BuildGetter(Type type, string propertyName)` that returns a DELEGATE reading the given instance property via reflection — and it must cache the PropertyInfo lookup work in the returned delegate (build once, call many). Also implement `static object? Read(object target, string prop) => BuildGetter(target.GetType(), prop)(target);` as the one-line convenience.

tests.name: getter-works
tests.hint: PropertyInfo.GetValue(target) wrapped in a lambda; the delegate captures the PropertyInfo.

tests.name: allocation-profile
tests.hint: Do the GetProperty work ONCE when building the delegate; the loop must not re-resolve.
